description: This Java source file implements a service class 'ExternalServicesPropertiesReadPlatformServiceImpl' that accesses external service configuration data such as S3 credentials, SMTP credentials, SMS gateway configurations, and notification settings from a database. It uses JDBC templates, row mappers, and result set extractors to retrieve and process data from database tables related to external services.

classes.name: S3CredentialsDataExtractor
classes.description: ResultSetExtractor implementation that retrieves S3 credentials from the database result set.

classes.name: SMTPCredentialsDataExtractor
classes.description: ResultSetExtractor implementation that retrieves SMTP credentials from the database result set.

classes.name: ExternalServiceMapper
classes.description: RowMapper implementation that maps external service property records, masking sensitive attributes like passwords.

classes.name: MessageGatewayDataExtractor
classes.description: ResultSetExtractor implementation that retrieves message gateway configuration from the database result set.

classes.name: NotificationDataExtractor
classes.description: ResultSetExtractor implementation that retrieves notification configuration data from the database result set.

methods.name: getS3Credentials
methods.description: Retrieves S3 credentials from the database.

methods.name: getSMTPCredentials
methods.description: Retrieves SMTP credentials from the database.

methods.name: getSMSGateway
methods.description: Retrieves SMS gateway configuration data from the database.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Retrieves external service properties for a given service name, with support for S3, SMTP, SMS, and Notification services.

methods.name: getNotificationConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves notification configuration data from the database.
